message.content: {"hts_code": "6802.93.0090", "reason": "Gneiss is classified with granite for tariff purposes, and the polished, sawn slabs are monumental or building stone merely cut/sawn and worked, falling under other granite subheading 6802.93."}
message.reasoning: Gneiss, worked stone slabs — 6802.93.0090? Gneiss is not marble/travertine/alabaster; 6802.93 covers granite. Actually gneiss classified under 6802.99. Slabs simply cut with polished top — worked: 6802.99.0090? Gneiss often treated as granite? CBP ruled gneiss under 6802.93.00 (granite). Actual ruling: Piracema White gneiss → 6802.93.0090? I recall NY ruling classifying gneiss as granite in 6802.93. Use 6802.93.0090.
